frontmatter.title: How to Load Spreadsheets Python

blocks.content: Aspose.Cells enables loading spreadsheets in Python to work with workbook data programmatically. Developers can load files such as XLSX, XLS, CSV, and others using the `Workbook` class from the `aspose_cells_foss` package.
Aspose.Cells -- Required installation and import statements.
For details on prerequisites, see the Aspose.Cells documentation.

Aspose.Cells enables loading spreadsheets from file paths, byte streams, or text streams using the `Workbook` class. Developers can specify load behavior via `LoadOptions` to handle different file formats and encoding preferences.

To load a spreadsheet from a file path, instantiate `Workbook` with the path string. For non-standard formats or custom parsing needs, pass a `LoadOptions` object alongside the path. Stream-based loading supports `io.BytesIO` or `io.StringIO` inputs, allowing in-memory processing without temporary files.

Common use cases include integrating with `openpyxl` workflows where data is preprocessed in pandas DataFrames, or using `openpyxl in python` pipelines that require conversion to Aspose.Cells for advanced formatting or export. The library also supports loading files previously saved by `openpyxl cell` operations, ensuring compatibility across Python-based spreadsheet toolchains.
This section demonstrates how to load a spreadsheet file using Aspose.Cells in Python. The example shows opening an Excel file, accessing its first worksheet, and printing a summary of its contents.

import aspose_cells_foss

# Load a spreadsheet file
workbook = aspose_cells_foss.Workbook("input.xlsx")

# Access the first worksheet
worksheet = workbook.worksheets[0]

# Print summary: number of rows and columns
print(f"Rows: {worksheet.cells.max_row + 1}, Columns: {worksheet.cells.max_column + 1}")
Aspose.Cells supports loading multiple spreadsheet formats in Python. The `Workbook` class handles file loading for all supported input types.

| Format | Extension | Notes |
|--------|-----------|-------|
| Microsoft Excel 97-2003 | .xls | |
| Microsoft Excel 2007+ | .xlsx | |
| Excel Macro-Enabled Workbook | .xlsm | |
| Excel Template | .xltx | |
| Excel Macro-Enabled Template | .xltm | |
| CSV | .csv | |
| Tab-Delimited Text | .txt | |
| OpenDocument Spreadsheet | .ods | |
| FODS (Flat XML ODS) | .fods | |
| HTML | .html | |
| MHTML | .mht, .mhtml | |
| Numbers (Apple) | .numbers | |
| SYLK | .slk | |
| DIF | .dif | |
| PDF | .pdf | |
| XPS | .xps | |
| SVG | .svg | |
| TIFF | .tiff | |
| PNG | .png | |
| JPEG | .jpg, .jpeg | |
| BMP | .bmp | |
| EMF | .emf | |
| GIF | .gif | |
| EPUB | .epub | |
